version: LOCK 70 V1 (9 Nov 2026) - the scholar's notebook, chapter 7: Fasting and seasons
builds_on: LOCK 3 (page 1, read with Idris), LOCK 34 runner, LOCK 51 (the last page). Every reference checked on sunnah.com; the game never shows the reference.

words.find_title: A page in the scholar's hand

words.story: Idris turns back through the pages. “{t}”

chapter.title: Fasting and seasons
chapter.story: He kept the fast through a winter of famine and gave his own bread away at every iftar.

pages.saying: The most beloved deeds to Allah are the most regular, even if they are small.
pages.idris: A little every day beats a lot once. Like digging a well.
pages.found: Wahb found a page lining an old hat bought from a pedlar.

pages.saying: The religion is easy; whoever makes it too hard for himself will be overcome. So aim for what is right, come close, and take heart.
pages.idris: Don't break yourself. Steady, not strained.
pages.found: Umm Hani hands you a loaf wrapped in an old page. “Look at the writing on this.”

pages.saying: Eat suhoor, for there is blessing in it.
pages.idris: Even a mouthful of water before Fajr. The blessing isn't in the size.
pages.found: Mukhtar found a folded page in a crack while mending a wall. “It's in a scholar's hand. You'll know who wants it.”

pages.saying: Whoever stands in prayer in Ramadan with faith and hoping for reward, his past sins are forgiven.
pages.idris: Tarawih is long and your legs ache. Read this page again.
pages.found: Children are flying a kite made from an old page. Sakhr buys it from them for a date and gives it to you.

pages.saying: Look for the Night of Power in the odd nights of the last ten of Ramadan.
pages.idris: He didn't tell us which night. So we stand on all of them.
pages.found: Amina found a page pressed inside a second-hand book.

pages.saying: If someone fasting eats or drinks forgetting, let him complete his fast - it was Allah who fed him.
pages.idris: Forgetting isn't failing. Finish the day.
pages.found: Ghazi has been using a page to wrap spices and has only just noticed the writing.

pages.saying: The Prophet was the most generous of people, and most generous in Ramadan, more generous than the wind sent with rain.
pages.idris: Ramadan is when the purse opens widest. Remember the iftars.
pages.found: Wahb pulls a damp page from the bottom of a basket and dries it for you.

pages.saying: Whoever gives food to a fasting person to break his fast gets the same reward, without taking anything from the faster's reward.
pages.idris: You fed the fasting at the masjid. Reward like a whole extra fast.
pages.found: Umm Hani found a page under a loose floor tile.

pages.saying: Zakat al-fitr was made obligatory - a measure of dates or barley - for every Muslim, to be given before people go out to the Eid prayer.
pages.idris: Before Eid prayer. Remember the measure of dates.
pages.found: Mukhtar was given a debt note - and the scholar's page is written on the back of it.

pages.saying: Fasting the day of Arafah, I hope, wipes out the sins of the year before and the year after.
pages.idris: Two years for one day. Saeed's sheep and the fast before it.
pages.found: Sakhr's little one folded a page into a paper boat. Sakhr dried it out for you.
